title: Rebrand remaining user-facing 'Flash' text to 'Dash'
description: Find and replace user-visible 'Flash' strings in the UI (not internal package names/types like FlashDocument, @flash/core which are code-level). Targets: (1) PublishSettingsDialog.tsx: 'Flash Version' label → 'Target Version', 'Flash Player 8 / SWF v8' → 'Dash / SWF v8'; (2) useFileActions.ts: FLA_FILTERS name 'Flash Document' → 'Dash Document'; (3) usePublish.ts: SWF_FILTERS name 'Flash Movie' → 'Dash Movie'; (4) apps/desktop/dist/index.html has stale 'Flash 8' title but that's the build output — the source index.html was already fixed in 0719; (5) check Shell.tsx for any visible 'Flash' in menu items, dialogs, tooltips. Do NOT rename package names (@flash/*), TypeScript types (FlashDocument), or technical strings like MIME types.
